description: Channel-agnostic human-in-the-loop for AgentFlow: user lookup, durable incidents with session windows, and out-of-band approval gates. State lives in Autonomous DB via ORDS; nothing blocks, no compute is pinned. SMS/Twilio is one adapter — set notify_mode=defer to deliver notifications over any channel the flow owns.

tools.description: Identify the person behind a verified channel ref (phone/email/slack id) and load their working context: role, current in-window incident, approvals awaiting their decision. Call FIRST on every inbound turn.

schema.name: user_ref
schema.description: VERIFIED channel identity from the relay (E.164 phone, email, slack member id). In a CODE flow, bind from the [meta64:] envelope at tool-construction time — never LLM-supplied.

credential_name.help: AIDP Credential Store display name OR OCI Vault secret OCID. Bundle keys: ords_username, ords_password (+ optionally ords_base_url, twilio_account_sid, twilio_auth_token, twilio_from_number).

ords_base_url.help: e.g. https://<adb-host>/ords/hitl_svc/hitl. Overridden by the bundle's ords_base_url if present.

session_window_minutes.help: How recently an incident must have activity to count as the 'current session' for a returning user. Default 30.

tools.description: Create a durable incident and return a short human-typable ID (e.g. K7M2Q4). Quote the ID in every outbound message so people can resume days later from any channel.

schema.name: requester_ref
schema.description: Verified channel identity of the person raising the incident.

schema.name: detail
schema.description: Optional structured context (JSON string is fine). Agents update this as they learn more.

tools.description: Load an incident + all its approvals by ID. Use when someone quotes an incident ID or LookupUserTool returned a current_incident. Reading refreshes the session window.

schema.name: incident_id
schema.description: The incident's short ID, e.g. K7M2Q4. Case-insensitive.

tools.description: Update an incident's summary/detail/status as the flow learns more. Status transitions to pending_approval happen automatically via OpenApprovalTool — don't set that here.

schema.name: status
schema.description: Optional status change: open | resolved | closed.

tools.description: Escalate an action to a human approver: writes the pending row, notifies every approver (SMS or deferred per notify_mode), returns an approval_id immediately. Nothing blocks. Link an incident_id to auto-park/unpark the incident.

schema.name: action_summary
schema.description: Plain-language description of what happens if approved. Include amount, destination, reason. Shown verbatim to the approver.

schema.name: action_payload
schema.description: The concrete action to execute on approval. Opaque to this tool. On approve, POSTed to conf.execute_webhook_url or returned as queued_action.

schema.name: requester_ref
schema.description: Verified channel ref to notify the outcome to.

schema.name: approver_allow
schema.description: Channel refs allowed to decide. List, JSON string, or comma-separated.

schema.name: incident_id
schema.description: Optional: link this gate to an incident. The incident is parked as pending_approval and auto-reopened on decision or TTL.

schema.name: conversation_ref
schema.description: Optional audit reference. Never gated on.

ttl_hours.help: Hours before an undecided approval is swept to 'expired'. Default 48.

notify_mode.help: auto = SMS via Twilio REST if creds in bundle, else defer. mcp = return notifications for the agent to deliver via its attached SMS/comms MCP tool (recommended for low-code MAS). defer = same as mcp, for non-MCP delivery (chat reply, email tool).

execute_webhook_url.help: Optional. On approve, the captured payload is POSTed here. Leave empty to have the calling flow dispatch the queued action.

tools.description: Apply an approver's decision. Authorization + atomic compare-and-set run server-side; exactly one resolution can win. On approve, executes the captured payload and notifies the requester. Result codes: ok / unknown / unauthorized / already_decided / expired.

schema.name: approval_id
schema.description: The approval ID the approver quoted. Case-insensitive.

schema.name: decision
schema.description: approve or reject (prefix-parsed: any a* / r* string works).

schema.name: sender_ref
schema.description: The approver's VERIFIED channel ref from the relay. Bind at tool-construction time from [meta64:] — never accept an LLM-supplied value.
